title: tab/permission
description: Engine-to-shell notification: the page asks for permissions (CefPermissionHandler::OnShowPermissionPrompt for geolocation, notifications, clipboard read and the rest; OnRequestMediaAccessPermission for camera, microphone and screen capture). The shell asks the person in a Visual Studio-style dialog and answers with tab/permissionAnswer; until then the page waits. Nothing is remembered between prompts: the profile is the workspace's, and each prompt is answered on its own.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

id.description: The prompt's id, unique in the engine process (shared with tab/dialog's ids).
